risk_factors.reason: Privileged role: Key Vault Secrets Officer

findings.title: Identity has direct access to a sensitive secret
findings.reason: The identity 'Current Azure User' has the 'Key Vault Secrets Officer' role, which provides access to the Key Vault containing 'app-secret'.
findings.impact: Compromise of this identity could allow an attacker to access sensitive Key Vault data.
findings.recommendation: Review the 'Key Vault Secrets Officer' assignment and reduce permissions to the minimum required.

remediation.action: Review the 'Key Vault Secrets Officer' role assigned to 'Current Azure User' and remove the assignment if access to 'app-secret' is not required.
remediation.least_privilege: If access is required, replace the role with the least-privileged role that provides only the required operation.
remediation.verification: Verify that 'Current Azure User' no longer has unnecessary access to 'app-secret'.

risk_factors.reason: Privileged role: Key Vault Secrets User

findings.title: Managed identity can reach a sensitive secret
findings.reason: The workload 'security-cloud-stack-app-01' uses a managed identity that is assigned the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role. That role provides access to the Key Vault containing 'app-secret'.
findings.impact: If the workload or its managed identity is compromised, an attacker may be able to access the sensitive secret.
findings.recommendation: Review whether this workload requires 'Key Vault Secrets User' access. Apply least privilege and remove unnecessary Key Vault permissions.

remediation.action: Review the 'Key Vault Secrets User' assignment for 'security-cloud-stack-app-01' and remove the role if the workload does not require access to 'app-secret'.
remediation.least_privilege: If access is required, replace the broad role with the minimum permission needed for the workload.
remediation.verification: Verify that 'security-cloud-stack-app-01' can no longer reach 'app-secret' through an unnecessary role assignment.
